editor.applicationHint: Optional. A snippet written for particular employers can say which.
editor.bodyRequired: A snippet with no text has nothing to paste.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.description: What you have typed here has not been saved anywhere, so leaving throws it away — and that cannot be undone.

both.upcoming: No upcoming reminder carries the selected keywords.
both.done: No completed reminder carries the selected keywords.

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.hint: works with no records and no connection
calculator.emptyDescription: The last thirty results stay here, so the second number can be compared against the first. Tap one to put it back on the display.
calculator.historyEntry: {{expr}} equals {{value}}. Put it back on the display

pageViewer.missingTitle: No saved copy on this device
pageViewer.missingDescription: Captures are kept where they were taken, so one made in the web app is not here. The record kept its name and its address.

fileViewer.openFailed: Nothing on this phone offered to open it.

typed.title: Recorded, not stored
typed.description: This one was filed by hand — a name, a type and a size for a document kept somewhere else. Edit it and choose a file to keep a copy here.

checking.title: Looking for the copy
checking.description: Checking whether the file this record points at is still in the app's storage.

kept.title: Kept on this device
kept.pageDescription: Opens here, with scripts off and no connection — the copy as the posting read on the day it was saved.
kept.fileDescription: Opens in whatever app on this phone handles the type. Nothing is uploaded, and nothing here reads what is inside it.

gone.title: The copy has gone
gone.description: This record points at a file that is no longer in the app's storage — most likely cleared by the system. The record is intact; choose the file again to attach it.

fileViewer.notFiled: Not filed under an application. Filing it puts it on those records and lets the graph find it from any of them.
fileViewer.noNote: Nothing written down about this one yet.
